General Purpose Cloud Server

An all-round solution for day-to-day computing, the General Purpose cloud server plans are designed with an abundance of configurable vCPUs and memory. The whole host of memory-to-vCPU ratio options gives you the highest level of autonomy to find a configuration most suited to your applications. vCPUs are shared in all General Purpose plans. This maximizes resource utilization and therefore minimizes your cost while delivering reliable performance for its value.

Dedicated Bandwidth

All LayerStack’s baseline cloud server offerings come with shared bandwidth. Upon reaching the allocated data transfer quota, cloud services continue with the possibility of throttled connection speed. If you wish to have guaranteed connection speed, dedicated bandwidth is your perfect choice.
